summary: This batch contains the Bravura music font assets: Bravura.json (a SMuFL-compliant font metadata file with engraving defaults, glyph advance widths, bounding boxes, ligatures, alternates, anchors, optional glyphs, and stylistic sets), FONTLOG.txt (a detailed version history changelog documenting Bravura's evolution from v0.1 in 2013 through v1.482 in 2026), and OFL.txt (the SIL Open Font License v1.1 text under which the font is distributed). Bravura is a Unicode typeface designed by Steinberg for music notation, compliant with SMuFL 1.2, containing thousands of musical symbols in the Unicode Private Use Area.

nodes.label: Bravura.json
nodes.description: Bravura font metadata file containing engraving defaults, glyph advance widths (3467 entries), bounding boxes (3434 entries), glyph alternates (226 entries), glyph anchors (643 entries), ligatures (201 entries), optional glyphs (528 entries), and 9 stylistic sets. Defines the SMuFL-compliant metrics and engraving parameters for the Bravura music font (v1.482).

nodes.label: FONTLOG.txt
nodes.description: Detailed version history and changelog for the Bravura font, documenting 40+ releases from v0.1 (May 2013) through v1.482 (August 2026). Covers SMuFL compatibility evolution, glyph additions and revisions, stylistic set definitions, and pipeline changes. All versions by Daniel Spreadbury.

nodes.label: OFL.txt
nodes.description: SIL Open Font License Version 1.1 (dated 26 February 2007). The license under which Bravura font software is distributed by Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH. Covers permissions, conditions, termination, and disclaimer terms for font use, modification, and redistribution.

nodes.label: engravingDefaults
nodes.description: 30 engraving default parameters for music notation rendering: barline spacing, beam thickness, stem thickness, slur thickness, staff line thickness, tie thickness, tuplet bracket thickness, text font family (Academico, Century Schoolbook, Edwin, serif), and more.

nodes.label: glyphAdvanceWidths
nodes.description: 3467 glyph advance width values defining the horizontal spacing of each glyph in the Bravura font. Includes Sagittal accidentals, clefs, noteheads, articulations, dynamics, barlines, and all other SMuFL-encoded symbols.

nodes.label: glyphBBoxes
nodes.description: 3434 bounding box definitions (north-east and south-west coordinates) for all glyphs in the Bravura font, used for hit testing, layout, and rendering bounds.

nodes.label: glyphsWithAlternates
nodes.description: 226 entries mapping base glyphs to their stylistic alternate variants, each with codepoint and name. E.g., 4stringTabClef maps to Tall and Serif variants.

nodes.label: glyphsWithAnchors
nodes.description: 643 entries defining stem connection points, cut-out regions, and origin points for glyphs that need precise alignment (e.g., accidentals with cutOutSE/cutOutNW/cutOutSW points, noteheads with noteheadOrigin, dynamics with opticalCenter).

nodes.label: ligatures
nodes.description: 201 ligature definitions combining multiple glyphs into single composed characters. Includes parenthesised accidentals, Johnston accidentals, time signature numerator/denominator combinations, chord symbol ligatures, and dynamics separators.

nodes.label: optionalGlyphs
nodes.description: 528 optional glyph definitions with classes (e.g., clefs, accidentals, noteheads, articulations, dynamics, barlines, time-signatures, chord-symbols, guitar, percussion, keyboard), codepoints, and descriptions. Includes serif/tall variants of clefs, bracketed accidentals, and editorial symbols.

nodes.label: sets (Stylistic Sets)
nodes.description: 9 OpenType stylistic set definitions (ss01 through ss10, excluding ss05 which was removed in v1.481): ss01 (small staff optical size), ss02 (short flags), ss03 (straight flags), ss04 (large outside-staff time signatures), ss06 (light-weight tuplet digits), ss07 (small chord symbol subscript/superscript), ss08 (oversized noteheads and slash noteheads), ss09 (large narrow time signatures), ss10 (figured bass accidentals with longer stems).

nodes.label: ss01 - Small Staff Optical Size
nodes.description: Stylistic set 01: smaller optical size glyphs for small staves, including clefs, time signature digits, noteheads, dynamics, and articulations.

nodes.label: ss02 - Short Flags
nodes.description: Stylistic set 02: short up-stem flags (8th through 1024th) designed to avoid collisions with augmentation dots.

nodes.label: ss03 - Straight Flags
nodes.description: Stylistic set 03: straight (non-curled) flag variants for all note values from 8th to 1024th, both up and down.

nodes.label: ss04 - Large Outside-Staff Time Signatures
nodes.description: Stylistic set 04: large, narrow sans serif time signature digits and symbols for display outside the staff.

nodes.label: ss06 - Light Tuplet Digits
nodes.description: Stylistic set 06: lighter-weight tuplet digits (0-9, colon) and parenthesised/bracketed tuplet markers.

nodes.label: ss07 - Small Chord Symbols
nodes.description: Stylistic set 07: smaller optical size chord symbols for subscript and superscript placement (half-diminished, diminished, augmented, major seventh, minor, and accidentals).

nodes.label: ss08 - Oversized Noteheads
nodes.description: Stylistic set 08: oversized versions of noteheads (double whole, square double whole, whole, half, black) and slash noteheads, merged from removed ss05.

nodes.label: ss09 - Large Narrow Time Signatures
nodes.description: Stylistic set 09: large, narrow bold serif time signature digits and symbols.

nodes.label: ss10 - Figured Bass Accidentals with Longer Stems
nodes.description: Stylistic set 10: figured bass accidentals (double flat, flat, natural, sharp, double sharp, triple flat, triple sharp) with longer ascenders and descenders.

nodes.label: Font Metadata (fontName, fontVersion)
nodes.description: Top-level font identification: fontName='Bravura', fontVersion=1.482. Version 1.482 corrected from originally-released 1.4900 since head.fontRevision cannot represent 4-digit fractions.

FONTLOG.txt documents the version history and changelog of Bravura font, including the version tracked in Bravura.json (v1.482)
OFL.txt provides the SIL Open Font License under which the Bravura font software is distributed
OFL.txt and FONTLOG.txt are co-located documentation files for the Bravura font
Both glyphAdvanceWidths and glyphBBoxes define per-glyph spatial metrics for the same set of glyphs
glyphsWithAlternates maps base glyphs to alternate variants; sets (ss01-ss10) define groups of alternate glyphs by stylistic purpose
ligatures compose multiple glyphs into single characters; optionalGlyphs defines additional glyphs that may participate in ligatures
engravingDefaults (e.g., staffLineThickness, stemThickness) influence how glyph advance widths are visually interpreted in layout
